basic_info.description: Welcome to 750 2nd Street, a 14-residence boutique building with just two homes per floor and direct elevator access into each home. Residence 401 features a 2-bed, 2.5-bath open-concept layout, with a kitchen that anchors the main living area, framed by wood-clad ceilings and walls that add warmth and contrast to the exposed concrete surfaces. The result is a modern, industrial aesthetic with a balanced, refined feel.  A wall of floor-to-ceiling windows spans the living and dining spaces, leading to a private terrace with iconic views of Oracle Park. A sleek linear gas fireplace adds warmth and definition, creating an inviting setting for relaxing or entertaining.  The European-inspired kitchen features Caesarstone countertops, a large island, Italian cabinetry, and high-end appliances. The primary suite includes a spa-inspired bath with warm-hued finishes, a quartz-clad vanity, and steam shower.  Located at the opposite end of the hallway, a second bedroom includes dual closets with custom cabinetry and access to the adjacent full bath.  Additional features include Plyboo floors and veneers, wine fridge, air conditioning, built-in AV and lighting systems, and in-home laundry. Located just minutes from Oracle Park, South Beach and Embarcadero restaurants, MUNI & Caltrain.
